shape: someone who lives far away now, and the one small habit you both kept

slides.text: living in different cities now, but we still [[leave two bites in the carton]] so nobody gets blamed for finishing it.

caption:
four hundred miles between our kitchens, and we still share the exact same reflexes from the fridge door.
you taught me every trick we got away with.
send this to the older sibling who knows why the box is never quite empty.

#siblings #siblinglove #oldersiblings #growingupwithsiblings
alt: A short post about living in different cities from an older sibling but still leaving two bites in the food carton so nobody gets blamed.
